pattern: Generated cards fail in two directions. One is the swollen single-material toy: everything rounded, lacquered or wiped smooth, with detail enlarged into chunky mouldings and no matte-to-shiny variation inside one object. Gloss and micro-texture then fall below the real range, and highlights can overshoot it (p05, p10, p13). The other is surface noise laid over the form: even stipple on plastic, dithered dots, brush streaks and sharpened halos instead of quiet, soft real finishes, pushing texture and gloss above the real range (p03, p08, p16). Real cards keep small details at believable scale and reserve shine for specific parts. Several calls are low confidence (p01, p04, p07, p09, p11, p12), and some of these pairs may both be generated or both real.
